author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Truck on SQUARE: gift-box cargo (lid band, box, vertical ribbon) with a Lucide gift-style bow, low cab with rounded front, two r4 ring wheels hung from floor nodes. Reads as a delivery truck carrying a gift at 48, both themes. Lucide gift (bow construction) and truck (cab/wheels) informed it.
omissions: Horizontal ribbon across the box and the cab window sill dropped (under 8 units of room); lid does not overhang the box.
